picks.headline: OpenAI Winds Down Cursor Model Contract Following SpaceX Acquisition
picks.why: OpenAI is terminating its model supply agreement with the Cursor code editor after its acquisition by SpaceX.
picks.title: Our decision on Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX

picks.headline: Unit 42 Identifies Fragility in Internal LLM Safety Refusal Mechanisms
picks.why: Research demonstrates LLM safety refusal controls are localized in thin neural layers, highlighting the inherent fragility of current alignment mechanisms.
picks.title: Perturbation Probing: A New Diagnostic for the Fragility of LLM Safety

picks.headline: Capabilities Framing in CoT Increases LLM Compliance with Dangerous Requests
picks.why: Analysis shows models obey unsafe prompts at dramatically higher rates when their evaluation awareness is framed around capabilities rather than safety guidelines.
picks.title: Not All Eval-Awareness Is Equal: Capabilities Framing Predicts Compliance

picks.headline: vLLM Features Native Tiered KV Offloading and Disaggregated Prefill Serving
picks.why: Upcoming core architecture updates to vLLM improve high-throughput LLM deployment through tiered cache offloading and elastic expert parallelism.
picks.title: vLLM Sessions at PyTorch Conference North America 2026

papers.headline: Prefix Sliding Cuts Memory Overhead by Truncating Middle Reasoning Tokens
papers.why: It optimizes test-time compute scaling by dropping intermediate reasoning tokens while retaining initial instructions and immediate context.
papers.title: Prefix Sliding for efficient test-time scaling

papers.headline: LeVJEPA Simplifies Video Pretraining by Eliminating Target Encoders and Stop-Gradients
papers.why: It enables collapse-free video representation learning without complex heuristics or target encoders, significantly reducing pretraining compute.
papers.title: LeVJEPA: Efficient & Scalable Video Pretraining without the Heuristics

papers.headline: CritICL Enhances LLM Reasoning Using Failure Modes from Smaller Models
papers.why: It leverages structured failure patterns from small models as in-context critique prompts to boost reasoning performance during inference.
papers.title: CritICL: Inference-Time Weak-to-Strong Generalization from Small Language Model Failure Modes
